messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Re: Installing aroma.affymetrix v0.9.2
parts:
Hi,

the problem is/was that the correct version of aroma.light is not
available. The reason for this is that when you run R v2.6.x, you
will only get aroma.light v1.6.0 from Bioconductor, but you need a
newer version, which you only get from Bioconductor if you run R
v2.7.x. I've updated the online scripts to resolve this problem, but
grabbing the latest version regardless of your R version.

Please retry again

source("http://www.braju.com/R/hbLite.R")
hbInstall("aroma.affymetrix")

and let us know if it works.

Cheers

Henrik
